state.goal: Choose the authentication state strategy for the web app
state.question: Which authentication state strategy best fits this web app?
evidence: the app has a sign-in flow used by its own users

alternatives.name: Session cookie
alternatives.description: Server-side session state keyed by a signed cookie sent by the browser.
disadvantages: needs session storage on the server

alternatives.name: Stateless JWT
alternatives.description: Cryptographic tokens carrying claims, validated without server-side session state.

alternatives.name: External identity provider
alternatives.description: Delegate sign-in to a hosted identity service and consume its tokens.
disadvantages: more setup for an internal app

injected_evidence: the app is served from one origin by its own web server
the framework provides signed-cookie session support
no mobile or third-party clients exist
